record.title: Observe one captured stock Sparrow identity reply
record.intent: Answer application liveness without replacing the failed ADB epoch gate.
requirements: Commit and push reviewed tasking and preparation before root executes exactly one isolated SCPI connection and one *IDN? request. Do not start ADB, touch controls, change scope settings or repeat a failed request.

Seal the full raw request-response and capture with exact termination statistics and host restoration evidence. Report actual responsive identity, timeout or explicit stop without treating it as accepted native policy, process epoch or RF measurement.
acceptance: A completed or explicitly stopped one-query observation has immutable evidence.
